_comment: Pre-declared before the first comparison against stock: V1/V2 of the proton-brem set with parent_sampler=envelope (brem.BremEnvelope). Committed before the jobs start; the result is judged only by the rule below.

previous_result.result: pass (V1 max |pull| 1.13, mean pull +0.06, chi2 p 0.90; V2 KS 0.54, min p 6.3e-4, max tail pull 2.70)

run.commit: the brem-envelope commit that adds this file (code as in 36eddb7; this commit changes no code)
run.set: brem (8 points: mb_brem and he_brem_cuboid at m_chi 1, 5, 20, 45 MeV)
run.trials: as validation/run_v_set.sh V_SET=brem (2e7 per point, 4 block-range shards, seed = the reference card's seed + offset)
run.reference: the same stock reference sets as every earlier brem run (phase0/out/ref, ref_w and the base cards' O2 runs)

envelope_validated_for_brem_if_all: the run passes every V1 and V2 criterion of v_config_brem.json
parent_over_bar = 0 in every shard (no envelope bound violation), and no shard fails a sampler check
decision_rule.repeat: only if the run fails: one repeat with seed_offset 1000000 (same commit, sampler, trials and GPU type), judged by the same two conditions; the envelope is then validated for brem only if the repeat meets both
decision_rule.no_third_run: a third run to obtain a pass is not allowed under this rule; it would need a new declaration with reasons
decision_rule.infrastructure: a shard that did not complete for a reason outside the port (node failure, time limit, preemption) is rerun with the same commit and seed; a shard stopped by a sampler check (over the bar, out of rounds) counts as a failure of the run
decision_rule.reporting: every run under this rule is reported whatever the outcome
